preconditions.expression: root is None or isinstance(root, TreeNode)
preconditions.description: The root must be either None or a valid TreeNode instance.
The target must be an integer between 1 and 10^4 (inclusive).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= node.val <= 10**4 for node in [root] + [node.left for node in [root] if root] + [node.right for node in [root] if root] if node] if root)
preconditions.description: All node values in the tree must be integers between 1 and 10^4 (inclusive).

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or (return_value == mirror_node and mirror_node is not None)
postconditions.description: If the mirror node exists, return its value; otherwise, return -1. The mirror node is defined as the node at the symmetric position in the opposite subtree of the root relative to the target node.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= node.val <= 10**4 for node in [root] + [node.left for node in [root] if root] + [node.right for node in [root] if root] if node] if root)
postconditions.description: The returned value (if not -1) must be a valid node value in the tree (1 to 10^4).
